name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Predictive input buffer: simulates your click ahead and holds it only if it would hit a hazard. Settings GUI on the pause menu, spam guard, overlay, practice tools.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the input buffer on or off.

predictive.name: Predictive mode
predictive.description: On: simulates your click a few ticks ahead and holds it only if it would hit a hazard. Off: classic delay buffer.

ground-ticks.name: Ground ticks (cube, ball, robot, spider)
ground-ticks.description: Max ticks a click is held while waiting to land / for a safe moment. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

flight-ticks.name: Flight ticks (ship, UFO, swing, wave)
flight-ticks.description: Max ticks a click may be held back in flying modes. Only used in Predictive mode, and only when the click would hit a hazard.

wave-release-ticks.name: Wave release ticks
wave-release-ticks.description: Max ticks a wave release may be held (predictive: only if releasing now would hit a hazard; classic: always).

release-ticks.name: Release ticks (other modes)
release-ticks.description: Max ticks other-mode releases may be held. 0 = off.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How far ahead the predictor simulates. Higher = safer predictions, more CPU.

spam-guard.name: Spam guard
spam-guard.description: When you click fast (3+ clicks closer than the spam interval) the buffer lets inputs through untouched.

spam-interval.name: Spam interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Clicks closer together than this count as spam. 20 ticks = 12 clicks/sec.

overlay.name: Input overlay
overlay.description: Shows buffered inputs and their delay on screen.

practice-buttons.name: Practice buttons
practice-buttons.description: On-screen Buf / Freeze / Step / Checkpoint buttons, shown only in Practice Mode and hidden while paused.

noclip.name: Noclip (practice mode only)
noclip.description: You do not die from obstacles. Only works in Practice Mode.

game-speed.name: Game speed (practice mode only)
game-speed.description: 0.10x to 2.00x. Only applies in Practice Mode.

button-scale.name: Pause button size
button-scale.description: Size of the Buffer button on the pause screen (right-middle).
